claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D3400 DSLR Camera With 70-300mm Lens.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black Nikon DSLR with a large zoom lens and a DX label on the lens barrel, but the exact camera model number (D3400) and the exact lens model/part number (70-300mm) are not readable from the provided angles.

claims.claim: Working perfectly ok with no fault.
claims.evidence: No proof of functionality is shown (no shutter test, autofocus test, sensor check, or screen/EVF operation). Photos only show physical appearance and wear.

risks.risk: Wrong model/lens (e.g., not actually D3400 or not actually 70-300mm), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the camera model text on the body (e.g., 'D3400') and a close-up of the lens model/part number and focal length markings (e.g., '70-300mm') so they are readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unspecified used Nikon DSLR with an unspecified zoom lens (worst-case value for unknown model/lens).

risks.risk: Non-working or degraded performance (shutter issues, autofocus failure, dead pixels, sensor dust, lens fungus/haze).
risks.proof: A short video showing: powering on, live view/EVF working, autofocus locking on a nearby object, and a shutter actuation test; plus a photo of a blank white wall at high ISO to reveal sensor dust.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'not fully tested / possibly faulty' and discount heavily for potential repair risk.

risks.risk: Physical condition worse than it appears (scratches/dents on screen/eyepiece, internal damage, lens haze/fungus not visible in these angles).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the LCD screen and viewfinder/eyepiece, and front/rear lens elements under light (to check haze/fungus), plus a straight-on shot of the lens glass.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for cosmetic wear and potential optical issues.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, lens hood, straps, manuals) reducing usability and resale value.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of everything included, showing each accessory clearly (battery model, charger, hood, caps, strap, box/manuals if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal/unknown accessories (worst-case: body + lens only).

risks.risk: Battery health/charge holding capacity is poor, causing short runtime.
risks.proof: A photo/video showing battery level after a short test (e.g., powering on and taking a few shots) and/or a battery health indicator if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'battery health unknown' and discount for likely reduced runtime.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the camera model number on the body (confirm 'D3400').
Clear close-up photo of the lens markings showing the exact lens model and focal length (confirm '70-300mm').
Short video test: power on, live view/EVF works, autofocus locks, and shutter fires.
Photo test for sensor dust: shoot a blank white wall at high ISO and show the result.
Close-up photos of LCD screen and viewfinder/eyepiece for scratches/damage.
Photos of front and rear lens elements under light to check haze/fungus.
Lay-out photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, memory card, lens hood, caps, strap, manuals/box if any).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Nikon DSLR with a zoom lens and some cosmetic wear, but the exact D3400 body and 70-300mm lens cannot be verified from readable markings, and functionality is not proven. Without those proofs, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
